method: Review rubric frozen from source-only page inventory before native or model outputs were inspected. Exact answers require visual source review; this is not certified ground truth. Review raw recovery, composed output and actual chunks separately; contradictory content counts as wrong.

checks.question: Preserve the introduction paragraphs and their reading order without introducing headings or merging unrelated paragraphs.
Trace every encoder/decoder arrow and residual path in Figure 1, preserving the shifted output input, masked attention, cross-attention source and Nx repetitions.
Preserve the exact scaled dot-product attention formula, Q/K/V roles, softmax/masking order and both diagrams without reversing arrows.
Preserve every Table 1 row with the complexity, sequential operations and maximum path-length column associations, including all exponents and variables.
Preserve every Table 2 model row, EN-DE/EN-FR scores, separate EN-DE/EN-FR training costs, blank cells and the Transformer base/big associations.
Preserve complete ordinary introductory French paragraphs, accents, citations and reading order.
Preserve all rows and grouped headers in Table 1, adaptation type, parameter count, ROUGE-L and human accuracy values with exact decimal values.
Preserve the entire Figure 1 bar chart: event labels, axis meaning/scale, ordering of bars and observed values or clearly marked approximations; retain accompanying text.
Preserve every factor f0-f6 header, proportion, signed cell value and footnote in the model/factor table, including shaded/bold annotations when meaningful.
Preserve the page conclusions and all table/figure relationships, especially which complexity factors affect which model families; do not substitute general explanations.
Read the actual English abstract and Chinese prose from the rendered source despite broken embedded font mappings; preserve words, references and numbers.
Preserve the three grammar-correction/feedback tasks and both examples in the diagram, including reach/to deletion versus explanation, and preserve prose.
Preserve all terminology/data counts and every table row with source-language labels, model/prompt text and column associations despite broken font mappings.
Preserve the complete page tables and formulas, exact models/conditions/metrics, row associations and footnotes, plus source prose.
Preserve all evaluation values, human-rating conditions and cross-language feedback examples with exact labels, numbers, punctuation and reading order.
Preserve the ordinary presentation text and table of contents without treating decorative page graphics as substantive claims.
Preserve country-to-emissions values, CO2-equivalent units, years and the entire emissions graph with series/legend associations and stated trend.
Preserve the water indicators table, absolute values versus biennial percentage changes, all units, and the map legend and national consumption value.
Preserve the non-university education enrolment table, totals, annual changes, country early-leaving rates and the 18-24 age/qualification definition in the footnote.
Preserve the digital-skills country table, age 16-74 denominator, household technology indicators with changes, and the online-purchasing time series and reported percentages.
Preserve methodological notes and definitions, separating contact/QR graphics from substantive statistical content.
Preserve all Table 1 multi-level headings, years, counts and signed percentage changes; preserve graph series and the distinction between domestic and overseas movement.
Preserve every prefecture row and grouped heading in Table 2, overseas/domestic components, signs, population units and both year comparisons.
Preserve every prefecture row and all 2024/2025 counts and net movement columns in Table 7, with signed changes and percentage qualifiers.
Preserve the three metropolitan-area net-migration series, signs, years, exact reported totals, and diagram explanations without confusing net inflow with total arrivals.
Preserve all introductory multi-column prose, correct order, umlauts and paragraph boundaries without dropping repeated substantive text.
Preserve every infographic relationship, category and number, including demographic context, labour-market measures and explanatory qualifiers.
Preserve the early-childhood infographic: age/region/category denominators, percentages, time comparisons, chart labels and arrows.
Preserve the higher-education diagram, all pathways between institution types, counts/percentages and their exact category/period associations.
Preserve the dense multi-column prose and all qualifications/negations without interleaving columns or splitting sentences at column boundaries.
Preserve all bilingual population table labels, years, units, footnotes and values, including estimates/provisional markers and geographic definitions.
Preserve the population pyramid: male/female sides, age bands, years, axis units, legend and actual distribution shape; do not invent printed numeric values.
Preserve all four bilingual labour tables, grouped years 2018/2022/2023, counts versus percentages, age and sex categories, revisions, total changes and labour-force footnote exclusions.
Preserve the bilingual merchandise-trade table, imports/domestic exports/re-exports and country groupings, all HK$ billion values and regional-bloc membership notes.
Preserve both reported-crimes and arrested-persons tables, exact year/category values, totals and the different population denominators in rate footnotes.
Preserve the scan abstract, the three calibrator types and all ranges/units; retain two-column reading order and the Figure 1 label associations.
Preserve all three formulas exactly, including fractions, squares, subscripts and cosine argument, definitions and units; retain the reported extrema.
Preserve all subplots of Figures 3/4/5, legend markers, flexure thicknesses, axes/units and waveform annotations without inventing curve values.
Preserve the portable pulse calibrator Figure 6 and its three-mass relationships, mass M2 as accelerometer attachment, release sequence and mechanical dimensions in the two-column text.
Preserve the centrifuge/acceleration apparatus diagram and all visible labels, equations and quantitative prose, with reading order and figure references.
